context.current_limit: GitHub Contents API file-size boundary is near; avoid another large inline append.
preservation_constraints: Preserve every source record and ID
Preserve every run update and limitation
Preserve all historical snapshots and graph addenda
Preserve provenance, checks, forecasts and outcomes
Do not reset, clean, stash, overwrite or discard user work

decision: Before the next substantive ledger append, design a lossless shard migration: move immutable historical source/run-update/limitation arrays into a versioned archive file with a cryptographic content digest and explicit record counts; keep the active ledger as a small index with archive pointers and latest snapshot/graph pointers. Do not perform the migration until a backward-compatible validator and regression tests verify exact record round-trip, unique IDs, zero missing references, digest match and index pointer integrity.
required_tests: Archive digest and record counts verify
Duplicate IDs and missing source references fail closed
Latest snapshot and graph pointers resolve after migration
safety: No source records are to be deleted. Keep the pre-migration ledger blob in Git history and archive the exact prior arrays. Migration must be proposed on a research branch and must not merge to main without approval.
next_action: Implement the archive schema and compatibility validator on a dedicated research branch before further ledger growth.
